purpose: Define the official BI collage UI pages, components, actions, evidence, and safety boundaries shared by testcase generation, package lint, helper planning, and result gates.

pages.purpose: Official BI entry page after auth and lease navigation.
Project/report list reached through My Custom > Collage Report.
Official collage report editor where metric rows, formulas, preview, save, and download flows are operated.

locatorStrategies: visible text for stable menu labels
role=button or role=treeitem with expanded state when exposed
nearby text fallback for nested menu items
interactionHazards: same text reused across navigation levels

components.purpose: Observe and toggle the company shared report group in the official sidebar.
locatorStrategies: visible text: 公司共享
role=button or role=treeitem with expanded/aria-expanded state
nearest nested report/project links after toggle
stateAssertions: expanded state changes after visible UI toggle
nested shared items become visible or hidden
interactionHazards: same group label may appear in multiple sidebar sections

components.purpose: Observe the logged-in user display in the top-right header.
locatorStrategies: topbar/right-side button text containing the user display name
button with disabled state near user/account region
visible text pattern from signed-in account

components.purpose: Read available projects/reports or detect a no-project state.
locatorStrategies: heading or table/list landmark near collage report page
row-local project/report name lookup
empty-state text lookup
row container containing source report control and field control
nth row only after reading visible row count
label-proximity within the row
interactionHazards: global text lookup may pick an option outside the target row
row DOM can rerender after source report changes

components.purpose: Select the source report for a metric row.
locatorStrategies: row-local combobox/button near source/report label
popover option text within the opened source picker

components.purpose: Select the metric field after source report is selected.
locatorStrategies: row-local combobox/button near field/metric label
field option text inside current picker only
interactionHazards: field picker can keep stale options after source report switch
same field names can exist under different source reports

components.purpose: Observe project/report list toolbar actions and disabled states.
locatorStrategies: toolbar region above project/report list
ordered icon buttons in the toolbar
button disabled/aria-disabled/computed pointer-events state
stateAssertions: download button disabled when no row is selected
delete button disabled when no row is selected
create button enabled when the list page is usable
interactionHazards: icon buttons may have no accessible name
tooltip text may only appear after hover
button order must be interpreted through the domain semantic map

components.purpose: Observe the report mode selector on the new report/editor page.
locatorStrategies: input name=report-mode
radio input value mapped through semanticMaps.reportModeRadio.values
nearest label text around each radio
stateAssertions: collage mode radio is checked by default
record-centric and metric-centric radios are not checked by default

components.purpose: Observe the official date range panel without requiring preview execution.
locatorStrategies: button aria-label=時間設置
panel containing preset buttons and dynamic/static tabs
panel footer containing 取消 and 確定
stateAssertions: panel opens after visible UI click
opening the panel does not trigger preview request
interactionHazards: panel may overlay other controls until closed
dynamic/static controls may be implemented as buttons rather than semantic tabs

components.purpose: Observe inline validation messages after invalid frontend operations.
locatorStrategies: visible validation text near metric rows
toast/alert/status region
body text delta after invalid click
stateAssertions: invalid operation does not trigger preview request

actions.purpose: Configure one or more official collage metric rows by source report and field.
Read official UI state for frontend presentation and flow cases without requiring preview execution.

policy: Helper emits current-run evidence only and never judges PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED.
Raw DOM and screenshots are artifacts for review, not the stable contract.
Tool Bridge response is conditional evidence and is required only when irreversible/native dialog execution is reached.
Official collage testcases should express metric setup as metrics[].sourceReport + metrics[].field.
Legacy field/sourceReport params may be normalized by compatibility code, but new cases should not rely on natural-language-only field setup.

forbidden: direct product API as testcase result source
